Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.

Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.

Repeat from step 3.

74-3609--127.easyPrerequisites: Untapped creatures you control have total power 2 or greater.
74-3609--127.description:
Activate Locus of Enlightenment using the Spacecraft's station ability by tapping a creature with power 1 or greater.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying its ability from step 1.
Resolve both Locus of Enlightenment abilities, putting a number of charge counters on it equal to twice the tapped creature's power.
If needed, repeat from step 1 until Locus of Enlightenment has three or more charge counters on it.
Activate Locus of Enlightenment using Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
74-3609--127.notes: Steps 1 through 4 can be skipped if Locus of Enlightenment has three or more charge counters on it.

Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.

Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Sporemound trigger.
